'''Meditation Garden Orenth''' was a meditation garden located within the [[Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]]. Attached to the side of one of the massive ships that made up the Temple's structure, the garden was suspended on a large platform extending out into the great open air of the canyon in which the Temple was erected. Amidst the exotic plant life was a large stone [[Orenth/Legends|Orenth]] character, after which the garden was named.

The garden was the site of an ambush by [[Jariah Syn]] on [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]] in vengeance for his [[Zareb Syn|father's]] [[Death/Legends|death]]. Tuum was able to subdue the violent pirate, and both parted with some sense of respect.
